subject: Mid-quarter OKR triage & QBR inputs — action plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter OKR triage & QBR inputs — action plan

Team —

Quick mid-quarter check and a short QBR prep ask. I ran a lightweight pass across the OKRs we committed to for Q3 and want to triage scope and dependencies so the QBR narrative is realistic. High level: two objectives are at risk if we don't re-scope or secure infra/SRE support this week.

Summary (very short):
- OBJ A (Serving performance): behind on latency targets because of the unplanned memory pressure in the dedicated GPU pools.
- OBJ B (Cost optimization): experiments on quantization are offline; need infra for dev environment and a 2-week burst slot to validate.

Asks (concrete):
1) By EOD Friday: each lead to send a 1-paragraph status + proposed scope rollback (if relevant) and owner for the remaining tasks. Use the attached QBR_input_template.xlsx.
2) Vivek / Marcus: we need a commitment for a 2-week burst of 4x A100-equivalents for validation and a priority SRE window for the first week of Aug. If we cannot get both, propose a reduced-scope plan.
3) Lauren: product narrative + customer impact examples (esp. on latency regressions) by Monday COB so we can include them in the QBR slide set.

Attachments: QBR_input_template.xlsx (spreadsheet) — blank template for status, risks, and asks.

I'll synthesize submissions and schedule a short triage slot (30m) Friday afternoon to lock decisions.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR triage & QBR inputs — action plan

Thanks Soojin — short reply and plan.

I can commit to the SRE window for the first week of Aug (Mon-Thu mornings) — I'll confirm headcount with SRE by EOD. Regarding the 2-week burst: infra can approve a 1-week burst at full capacity starting Aug 2; to get 2 weeks we'd need a budget exception or deprioritization in other pools.

Options for OBJ A (propose pick one):
A) Full validation: 2-week burst + SRE support (best case; pushes other infra work by one week)
B) Reduced scope: validate a single model family (reduce coverage to Llama3 variants) in 1-week burst + SRE (fastest path to showing progress for QBR)
C) Defer validation to post-QBR and present remediation plan + timeline (low risk to infra budget but hurts product narrative)

I'll attach the infra_ticket_list.csv with the current queued tickets and will tag the tickets that must move to P0 if we pick A or B.

On the quantization experiments for OBJ B: we need a dedicated dev node with the right CUDA stack; Marcus, can you confirm if the current images are compatible?

-Vivek
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR triage & QBR inputs — action plan

On Thu, Jul 30, 2026 at 9:45 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — short reply and plan.
> 
> I can commit to the SRE window for the first week of Aug...

Adding constraints from the serving/runtime side:
- Memory pressure is not only infra allocation — we have an identified regression in the latest runtime patch that increases KV cache overhead for long-context workloads. We'll need a small patch (estimated 3 days dev + 2 days QA) to test with the burst. That patch is in a draft PR but requires SRE time to schedule a canary run.
- The dev node images Vivek mentioned will need CUDA 12.1 + cuDNN 9; current dev images are at CUDA 12.0. We can upgrade but need an image build slot and smoke test (1 day).

Attached: cost_model_notes.pdf — quick note on expected token costs if we proceed with A vs B above (high level numbers).

Recommendation: pick option B (reduced scope + 1-week burst + SRE). It's the lowest friction to show measurable progress in the QBR and buys time to finish the runtime patch. If leadership prefers a bold stance for the QBR, we can escalate for budget exception but need sign-off from finance by Friday.

-Marcus
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter OKR triage & QBR inputs — action plan

Thanks for the quick returns — consolidating decisions here so we have one source of truth for the QBR deck. Sarah, including you for transparency on the customer impact language; we'll only include anonymized examples in the public QBR slides.

Decisions (locked for QBR narrative):
- We will take option B for OBJ A: reduced scope + 1-week burst (Aug 2–Aug 9) + SRE priority window. Vivek to confirm exact SRE reps by EOD Friday.
- OBJ B will get the dev image upgrade and a dedicated dev node; Marcus to own image build and smoke test (ETA Aug 2).
- We'll present the mitigation plan + expected dates in the QBR rather than a full remediation claim. Lauren, please draft the narrative paragraph and 2 anonymized customer impact bullets by Monday COB.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Vivek: confirm SRE reps + schedule P0 canary run (due 2026-07-31 COB) — assign: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
- Marcus: complete image build + smoke test; merge runtime patch to canary branch (due 2026-08-02) — assign: marcus_lin@redwood.com
- Lauren: QBR narrative + customer-impact bullets (due 2026-08-03 COB) — assign: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
- Soojin: synthesize inputs, update QBR slide master, and lead triage meeting Friday 15:00 PT (calendar invite sent) — due 2026-07-31 15:00 PT

Links and attachments: QBR_input_template.xlsx (template), cost_model_notes.pdf (attached), infra_ticket_list.csv (attached). Drive folder for working artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRinput-Redwood-July2026

If anything changes, flag it in this thread. Appreciate the rapid alignment.

Best,
Soojin
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
